summary: Conducting applied research on Human-AI collaboration, AI developer tools, and personalization across research direction, system architecture, model orchestration, experiments, and publications. Hands-on work spans LLM deployment, backend services, Docker/Linux environments, Linux administration, and MLOps workflows.

technicalCapabilities.title: Agentic AI & LLM Systems
technicalCapabilities.description: Coding-agent architecture, multi-model orchestration, adaptive context and memory, knowledge-graph reasoning, RAG, evaluation pipelines, and vLLM-based model serving.

technicalCapabilities.title: AI Platforms & Backend Engineering
technicalCapabilities.description: Python services, FastAPI and Django APIs, TypeScript editor integrations, Git/GitHub automation, workers, analytics, and database-backed product workflows.

technicalCapabilities.title: Infrastructure, Evaluation & Delivery
technicalCapabilities.description: Docker and Linux environments, Linux administration, MLOps, sandboxed execution, browser automation, and reproducible experiment infrastructure.

focusAreas.title: Developer Behavior Modeling & Personalization
focusAreas.description: Led behavioral intelligence research for AI-assisted software engineering, developing methods to infer developer intent, AI usage patterns, workflow habits, and recurring task routines from repository and interaction evidence. This work resulted in two research papers.

focusAreas.title: Adaptive LLM Code Assistance
focusAreas.description: Led the design and evaluation of context-aware developer assistance spanning adaptive invocation, suggestion timing, output filtering, contextual support, and multi-model LLM serving for code completion, chat, and repository-aware assistance. This work contributed to two research papers.

focusAreas.title: ITMO Code — AI Education Platform
focusAreas.description: Transformed the open-source Roo-Code coding extension into ITMO Code, a full-stack AI development platform for education. Designed and implemented editor-native AI assistance, role-based workflow orchestration, Git/GitHub automation, sandboxed execution, agentic code review, backend APIs, a database layer, workers, analytics, and automated pipelines.

focusAreas.title: Agentic Systems & Evaluation
focusAreas.description: Conducted research on repository-grounded coding agents, issue localization, repository-level software repair, agent evaluation, and stage-aware pipelines. Evaluated how model effort can be allocated across exploration, localization, repair, and validation, connecting directly to my PhD direction in Adaptive Human-AI Collaboration via Agentic Systems.

focusAreas.title: Multimodal Data & Web Agents
focusAreas.description: Developed agentic systems for conversational data analysis and browser automation, including sandboxed execution, agent orchestration, multi-step reasoning, visualization, and multimodal interaction.
